summary: Comprehensive testing of Phase 6 features for Heroic HIFI Foundation: Profile page, Badges system, Grievance Tickets, Password Reset, Admin User Management, and Special Drives. All 27 backend tests passed. Frontend UI tests passed for all new pages and features.
passed_tests: GET /api/profile returns profile with badges, volunteer_hours, total_donated, profile_pic_path, status
POST /api/auth/forgot-password sends reset link (debug mode returns link)
POST /api/auth/forgot-password with non-existent email returns success (security)
POST /api/auth/reset-password resets password with valid token
Helping Hero badge is auto-assigned to all new members
Century Hero badge auto-assigned when volunteer_hours >= 100
GET /api/directory returns badges and volunteer_hours for members
Frontend: /profile page renders with stats, badges, edit form, upload button
Frontend: /tickets page with form to create ticket and ticket list
Frontend: /reset-password page with forgot password flow
Frontend: Home page shows new Special Drives (Birthday, Memorial, Seasonal Aid cards)
Frontend: Admin Dashboard has Tickets tab with ability to respond and change status
Frontend: Admin Dashboard Users tab has promote/demote, suspend, hours input, merchandise checkbox, comments, badge management
critical_code_review_comments: Badge auto-assignment logic in compute_auto_badges() is well-implemented with clear conditions
Password reset flow properly uses secure tokens with 30-minute expiry
Suspended user check in login endpoint correctly returns 403 with reason
Profile endpoint triggers auto-badge computation on each call - efficient for real-time badge updates
Directory endpoint correctly excludes sensitive fields while including badges and volunteer_hours
seed_data_creation: Test users created during backend tests are automatically cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 6 features (Profile, Badges, Tickets, Password Reset, Admin User Management, Special Drives) are fully implemented and tested. Badge auto-assignment happens on GET /api/profile call. Admin-only badges (Star Volunteer of Month/Quarter/Year, Top Donor, Rising Star) can only be added via POST /api/admin/users/{email}/badge. The 'Helping Hero' badge is auto-assigned to ALL new members during registration. Existing test users in DB may not have badges/volunteer_hours fields - only users created via the new registration flow have them. Password reset uses debug mode (returns link in response) when Resend API key is not set.

mocked_apis.Razorpay: Payment verification mocked - placeholder env keys
mocked_apis.Resend: OTP and password reset email delivery mocked - debug mode returns OTP/link in response
